item.title: Admin Post - Info - Open
item.content:encoded:
Long overdue, but the Guide Hub has received a facelift! Here are the changes:

  • All current (non-archived) pages tagged with "guide" and "essay" should now be listed.
  • Guides and Essays are noted with color-coding.
  • Explanations of what Guides and Essays are has been added.
  • Sections have been reorganized.
  • Collapsibles implemented for Guides for Writing.

Many, many thanks to TSATPWTCOTTTADC who compiled lists, set page parents, and provided help with coding as I struggled with making this look presentable.

item.content:encoded:
You might want to add a basic table tutorial, like I did here.
+ show block
– hide block

Hello! this is the tutorial for making tables for making tables, tables are useful for test logs, explore logs and more, I will teach you how to make them here is an example of a table.

DISCLAIMER: this is a BASIC cell tutorial, so if you want an advanced ask someone else

[[collapsible]]
mixing colours
Colour 1 Colour 2 Output
blue red purple
yellow red orange
blue yellow green

First of all you need to know how to make the vertical pipe symbol.To do it on QWERTY keyboards you press shift and press the \ button, or if you forget just copy it off some other internet site.

 |||||| (title name) ||

to add a section under the title you do this

 || example ||

now your cell should be something like this

(title name)
example

this is what the code should look like.

 |||||| (title name) || || example ||

To shade a cell you put the ~ symbol between the last | symbol and speech, remember to put a space.

(title name)
example

this is what the code should look like.

 ||||||~ (title name) || ||~ example ||

To add multiple cells you add after the last || symbol, like this

 || example || example 2 ||

and you will get something like this

(title name)
example example

the code should look like this

 |||||| (title name) || || example || example ||

You can add as much cells as you like, but after the 3rd cell you have to add two | symbols for each cell

(title name)
example example example

the code should look like this

 |||||| (title name) || || example || example || example ||
(title name)
example example example example

or

(title name)
example example example example

The code for the table above

 |||||||| (title name) || || example || example || example || example ||

To add cells under you add another || example || a line lower

like this

(title name)
example example example example
example 
 |||||||| (title name) || || example || example || example || example || || example ||

you can do this as much as you like

(title name)
example example example example
example example example example
example example example example

the code for that cell looks like this

 |||||||| (title name) || || example || example || example || example || || example || example || example || example || || example || example || example || example ||

you can also make irregular shapes

(title name)
example example example example
example example example
example example 
 |||||||| (title name) || || example || example || example || example || || example || example || example || || example || example ||

You can add long blocks anywhere, just remember the extra | symbols

(title name)
example example example example
example example example
example
example

the code

 |||||||| (title name) || || example || example || example || example || || example || example || example || |||| example || || example ||

The cells will adapt automatically to any size of sentence you write, so dont worry about that, you can also use all the speech code like bold italic underline strikethrough.

(title name)
example example example example
example big box big box example example example example example
example
example

So this is all for the table tutorial, I hope you learned how to make tables properly, enjoy making your test logs and other things.
